## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds or changes one file in `entries/` and nothing else (the build runs after the merge).
- [ ] I searched open and closed issues and pull requests, and the entry is not listed yet.
- [ ] The resource is public, in English, at least 30 days old, and (for a repository) not archived and pushed within the last 12 months.
- [ ] The description is one factual sentence, at most 160 characters, ending with a dot, without promotional words.
- [ ] Every OTel field (`otlp`, `conventions`, `telemetry`) is backed by the public page in `otel_evidence` or `telemetry_docs`, or set to `unknown`.
- [ ] The license comes from the project's LICENSE file or terms (`unknown` if unclear).
- [ ] `npm run validate -- --no-drift` passes.
- [ ] I work on this project: yes / no (if yes, `vendor_affiliation` is set).
- [ ] A person (me) is submitting this and will answer the review, even if AI tools helped prepare it.
